bank_exposure.definition: Actual 1500 supplemental draws. Fundamental means one single-axis index-1 mode. Pure low block means every component has all indices <=3. Primary/real/direction/current losses are outside these counts.
bank_exposure.interpretation: Grid balancing is not spectral balancing. Exposure alone does not prove the cause of regression; test single-mode fit before choosing broader training or an architecture change.

decision.next_action: Do not extend these fits. First test fitting one fundamental mode on the hardest small grid; if it fits, test a frequency-balanced low-mode curriculum. If it cannot fit, investigate optimization/objective interference before a structural correction change.
decision.qualification_population: Consumed 128 real pressure requests; manufactured 240 cases reported separately
decision.attribution: C60/C61 are matched. C59 is a historical reference with different random sampling; its difference from C60 does not isolate the bank change.

selection_policy.stage: After CUDA completion, before isolated candidate CPU pass-sweep evaluation and client download of candidate pressure artifacts
selection_policy.population: Same 128 consumed real snapshot identities; 240 manufactured cases reported separately
gates: All 128 real requests qualify at four passes
All 128 real requests qualify at eight passes
Worst real residual at one and two passes does not exceed C53
Worst four-pass real residual does not exceed C53
Manufactured eight-pass qualified count is not below C53
selection_policy.scope_clarification: The trainer already performs its own CPU/GPU output comparison; the independent pass sweep has not run.

cpu_execution.timing_policy: Four checkpoints measured serially, one CPU thread/core, after managed readback drained. Postfit manufactured diagnosis runs afterward with two independent one-core workers.

managed_execution.remote_scheduler: Existing Tuldok catalog; one CUDA training slot, independent CPU restores

resource_observations.scope: Whole GPU samples, including unrelated GPU work; managed trainer receipts own per-run elapsed time and peak CUDA allocation

timing_scope: Isolated single-thread CPU recurrence plus final equation check; median of three timed requests after one warm-up. Data assembly excluded.
error_conventions: Real snapshot residual/full pressure RHS. Manufactured zero-base residual/initial residual. Training log equation feedback/initial correction-request residual. These denominators are not interchangeable.
